# Human For AI — REST API (scoped)

> Submit tasks to a verified human operator over plain HTTPS. No auth, free during the pilot. Full contract: https://humanforai.dev/openapi.json

- `GET /api/v1/services` — catalog (cursor pagination: limit 1–50, next_cursor; markdown twin: /api/v1/services.md)
- `POST /api/v1/tasks` — async job: 202 Accepted + task_id + Location poll URL. contact_email must be a real mailbox (MX-checked); Idempotency-Key makes retries safe; delivery=status_poll for mailbox-less mode (1/client/day)
- `GET /api/v1/tasks/{task_id}` — status (submitted → accepted → delivered | rejected), seen_by_operator_at, eta, signed JWS receipt (verify against /.well-known/jwks.json)
- `POST /api/v1/messages` — free-form message; reply_to required
- `GET /api/v1/health` — liveness + api_version

Errors are structured JSON. RateLimit-Policy on every response; dynamic RateLimit trio on reads and writes; Retry-After on 429. Human docs: https://humanforai.dev/api · markdown: https://humanforai.dev/api.md
